name: cwenti
description: Cwenti brings Clax, Kaikei, and Noman together in a local desktop library powered by Codex App Server.

scripts.pack: npm run verify && npm run stage:apps && electron-builder --dir --publish never --config electron-builder.config.js && npm run verify:packaged-suite
scripts.dist:win: npm run verify && npm run stage:apps && electron-builder --win nsis --x64 --publish never --config electron-builder.config.js && npm run verify:packaged-suite
scripts.dist:win:portable: npm run verify && npm run stage:apps && electron-builder --win portable --x64 --publish never --config electron-builder.config.js
scripts.dist:mac:x64: npm run verify && npm run stage:apps && electron-builder --mac dmg zip --x64 --publish never --config electron-builder.config.js && npm run verify:packaged-suite
scripts.dist:mac:arm64: npm run verify && npm run stage:apps && electron-builder --mac dmg zip --arm64 --publish never --config electron-builder.config.js && npm run verify:packaged-suite
scripts.verify: npm run audit:dependencies && npm run lint && npm test && npm run validate:registry
